items.title: Weighted radial Gaussian and its exponential expectation

source.anchor: §6.1 Gaussian variance calculation immediately before Eq. (51), and Eq. (51)
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, CC BY 4.0. Samplinglib makes the fixed-location law and integrability explicit.

items.statement: Fix a deterministic spatial point and deterministic level weights. Under the original joint Gaussian law of the actual coefficient vector, the weighted radial sum W is centered Gaussian with exact variance V. Its negative exponential is integrable and has expectation exp(V/2). This is the fixed-location quantity m(x) in Eq. (51).
assumptions: The actual fields all use the same fixed location and the original unconditioned coefficient vector. Ordered tensor degrees, cutoffs, exact amplitudes, and the zero-block convention are unchanged.

The paper prescribes deterministic positive weights by Eq. (18) and large n with a particular depth. This finite identity holds for arbitrary deterministic real weights and all positive n and natural h; no admissibility or recursive weight estimate is generalized.
Only the coefficient vector is integrated. Zero variance is allowed. No spatial regularity, restriction to a good event, conditional law, or exponential moment is assumed.

formulae.label: Exact cutoff from footnote 2 and Eq. (16)
Angular model and variance scale
formulae.tex: \begin{gathered}K=2^{74(h+1)},\quad P=2^{64(h+1)},\quad S_i=\sum_{j=0}^{h-i}K^j,\quad \mathcal P=\{4,6,\ldots,P\},\\ a_{i,p}=\frac1{p^4S_i^2\sqrt{(h-i+1)\log(2PS_i)}},\quad v_i=\sum_{p\in\mathcal P}a_{i,p}^2,\\ \psi_i(u)=\bigotimes_{j=i}^h u_j^{\otimes K^{j-i}},\qquad F_i^\Xi(u)=\sum_{p\in\mathcal P}\sqrt n\,a_{i,p}\langle\Xi_{i,p},\psi_i(u)^{\otimes p}\rangle.\end{gathered}

formulae.label: Actual one-point law
formulae.tex: \begin{gathered}H_i^\Xi(x)=\begin{cases}0 & \exists j\ge i:\ x_j=0,\\C_i(x)\,F_i^\Xi((x_j/\|x_j\|)_{j=i}^h)&\text{otherwise},\end{cases}\\ H_i^\Xi(x)\sim\mathcal N(0,n C_i(x)^2 v_i),\qquad \mathcal N(0,0)=\delta_0.\end{gathered}

formulae.label: Weighted Gaussian and exact Eq. (51) expectation

obligations.label: Derive the centered weighted law with the exact variance from the actual joint model
Prove the exponential integrable and compute the expectation in Eq. (51)

bindings.boundary: One fixed-location linear Gaussian sum and its Eq. (51) exponential expectation. No spatial integration M, cutoff or gate bound, nonlinear load identity outside the good event, conditional or tilted law, mass estimate or lower bound.

assumption_deltas.source: Large n, prescribed h and deterministic positive weights β_i from Eq. (18).
assumption_deltas.lean: Any positive n, natural h and deterministic real weights for this identity.
assumption_deltas.reason: Linear Gaussian scaling uses β_i² and does not require positivity. Specializing to the paper's weights recovers the exact source equation, not a broader lower bound.

assumption_deltas.source: The actual linear radial field at fixed x under μ_n.
assumption_deltas.lean: The same literal radial tails and coefficient model, with variance-zero factors retained.
assumption_deltas.reason: No independent copy or different cutoff is introduced, and the expectation is not with respect to γ_n.

assumption_deltas.lean: Integrability is an explicit conclusion under the actual Gaussian law.
assumption_deltas.reason: Gaussian MGF at −1 is finite and strictly positive. Lean checks integrability explicitly rather than inferring it from a totalized integral without justification.
